releases.body:
Read the Go allowance from the catalogue, not from a table that is gone

The plan page lost its per-model table, so every refresh parsed nothing and a
week-old allowance was served as today's; a promotion could never appear. A kept
copy now names its day, and a price change scheduled upstream is no peak tariff.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md
